prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 14 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1460; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection and was diagnosed with a fracture of the wrist. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the crash described. Over the course of 14 visits, care followed a typical progression: initial immobilization, followed by serial examinations and imaging to confirm alignment and healing, and then a gradual reduction in visit frequency as function improved. Physical examination revealed findings that support the fracture, including localized tenderness and reduced grip strength on the affected side, while other neurovascular and range-of-motion tests were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury to the same area, and none is recorded in our history. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate entries. The patient is now progressing well and is expected to return to normal activity with ongoing monitoring as needed.
